info.name: Z-Salon API — Appointments & Management
info.description:
Postman collection for the Z-Salon multi-tenant salon backend.

Covers: Branch Management, Customers, Appointments (walk-in, phone/staff, online), Availability, Service Usage, Appointment Payments, Payment Receipts, Refunds, Customer Appointments, Public Booking, and Feedback.

## Setup
1. Set `baseUrl` and `businessId` in collection variables.
2. Run **Auth › Login** first — it captures `accessToken` automatically.
3. Create a branch / customer / service / staff, then capture their IDs from responses (scripts are included on key requests).

## Time Handling
- All datetimes in request bodies must be **ISO 8601** (e.g. `2026-09-24T09:00:00.000+03:00` — Ethiopia is GMT+3 / Africa/Addis_Ababa).
- Availability `date` params are plain **YYYY-MM-DD**, interpreted in the **branch timezone**.
- Responses return ISO 8601 UTC (`Z`); availability responses also echo the branch `timezone` and offset-based slot times.
- Client-supplied `scheduledEnd` is ignored — duration comes from the service config.

Full reference: `docs/ENDPOINTS-GUIDE.md`.

request.description:
Staff/admin login. Returns `accessToken` (captured into collection variable) and sets the httpOnly `refreshToken` cookie.

OTP alternative: `POST /auth/otp/request` → `POST /auth/otp/verify` → `POST /auth/login/complete`.

Purposes: LOGIN, REGISTRATION, PASSWORD_RESET, PHONE_VERIFICATION, INVITATION_ACCEPTANCE, PHONE_CHANGE.

Used for public booking (PHONE_VERIFICATION) before `POST /public/.../bookings`.
Returns `{ verificationToken }` (captured). Consumed later by the public booking endpoint.
Rotates tokens using the httpOnly `refreshToken` cookie — enable cookie sending (Postman cookies are automatic per domain).
Auth: Bearer + membership + BRANCH_CREATE. Timezone must be a valid IANA id (defaults to business timezone). 409 on duplicate branch name.
Auth: Bearer + membership + BRANCH_VIEW or BUSINESS_VIEW.
Note the path shape: `/{businessId}/branches/{branchId}`.
Exactly 7 entries; dayOfWeek 0=Sunday … 6=Saturday. Times are branch-local HH:mm (24h).
isClosed:true blocks the whole branch-local date. With intervals, it replaces weekly hours for that date. 409 if an override exists for that date.
Search only — returns `{ matched, customer }`. Walk-in flow step 1: search, and register if not found.
Only one phone may be isPrimary (400 MULTIPLE_PRIMARY_PHONES). Duplicate phone → 409.
Soft delete — archived customers cannot book.
Find by phone, or create with the given names. Response: `{ customerId, isNew }`. Captured into customerId.
Lookup only. `{ matched: true, customerId, customer }` or `{ matched: false }`.

item.name: Get available slots (per day, staff filter optional)

query.description: YYYY-MM-DD, interpreted in the branch timezone

request.description:
Works without auth (optionalAuth). Slots merged across qualified staff by start time; each slot lists available staff. `startTime`/`serviceEndTime`/`reservedEndTime` are ISO with the branch UTC offset (+03:00).

Response `data.availableSlots[0].startTime` is captured into `bookingStart`.

item.name: Branch operating intervals for a date
Staff effective intervals for a date

request.description: Always returns 200 with `{ valid, overrideAllowed, conflictType, reason }`. conflictType values: BRANCH_CLOSED, SERVICE_NOT_OFFERED, STAFF_INACTIVE, STAFF_NOT_QUALIFIED, STAFF_NOT_WORKING, STAFF_ON_BREAK, STAFF_TIME_OFF, SLOT_OUTSIDE_BRANCH_HOURS, SLOT_CONFLICT, MIN_ADVANCE_VIOLATION, MAX_ADVANCE_VIOLATION, INVALID_START_TIME, BUSINESS_INACTIVE.
scheduledStart optional — defaults to now in branch timezone. Client scheduledEnd is ignored. Initial status: CHECKED_IN. Requires branch walkInEnabled.
bookingSource: STAFF | PHONE. Initial status CONFIRMED. If the service has a deposit policy, add paymentMethodId + amount (+paymentReference) or the request fails 400.
Online booking source. Initial status CONFIRMED, or PENDING when deposit/approval is required.

query.description: PENDING | CONFIRMED | CHECKED_IN | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED | CANCELLED | NO_SHOW | EXPIRED

request.description: Notes-only update in current code. Reschedule/staff/status have dedicated endpoints.
newStartTime required (ISO 8601). staffId optional — moves to another qualified staff. 409 on conflict; 400 for terminal statuses.
State machine: PENDING→CONFIRMED|CANCELLED|EXPIRED; CONFIRMED→CHECKED_IN|CANCELLED|NO_SHOW; CHECKED_IN→IN_PROGRESS|CANCELLED|NO_SHOW; IN_PROGRESS→COMPLETED|CANCELLED.
IN_PROGRESS only. Widens the staff busy window; scheduledStart/End never change. 409 if it overlaps the staff's next appointment.
actualEnd optional — defaults to now. Must be after scheduledStart. Releases the staff early; scheduled times untouched.
Only CONFIRMED appointments can become NO_SHOW.
refund:true creates a PENDING RefundRequest for refundAmount (defaults to the full PAID amount; capped at paid total).
Replaces the assignment. New staff must be active, in the branch, qualified, and slot-free (409 otherwise).
Always 400: appointments must have exactly one staff member — reassign instead. Early release = complete with actualEnd.
Staff manually confirms the customer showed up. 400 if already confirmed.

request.description: Requires customerCancellationEnabled=true. Blocked inside cancellationWindowMinutes. If PAID money exists and the policy (ALWAYS / BEFORE_DEADLINE + refundDeadlineHours) allows, a PENDING RefundRequest is created for the admin queue.

Run 0. Auth › OTP request + verify first. Token purpose must be PHONE_VERIFICATION and match the phone. Find-or-creates the customer. Initial status PENDING (deposit/approval) or CONFIRMED.

item.name: Submit receipt for pending public booking

request.description: The raw token from the customer's SMS link is the authorization mechanism. Only enabled categories are returned. 404 unknown token · 410 expired · 409 already submitted or appointment not COMPLETED.
One answer per category; response type must match the category type (RATING/TEXT/BOOLEAN). Single-use token — a second submit returns 409.
Optional query filters: from_date, to_date, branch_id, category_id, is_anonymous. Anonymous items return customer: null and appointment: null. BRANCH_MANAGER and STAFF get 403.
Records a FEEDBACK_VIEWED audit event (no customer identity in metadata).

request.description: RATING requires integer ratingScaleMin < ratingScaleMax within 0..10; TEXT/BOOLEAN require the scale to be null. Names are unique per business.
Includes disabled categories and response_count per category.
Update name/description/sortOrder or disable. No delete. Type/scale become immutable once a category has responses (409 FEEDBACK_CATEGORY_IMMUTABLE).
